subject.title: fix(feishu): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should Feishu inbound message-resource streams use the existing 120-second media timeout as their chunk-idle deadline, or intentionally introduce a stricter fixed 30-second cutoff?
rationale: Both values fix the indefinite hang, but choosing 30 seconds changes which slow downloads are accepted and can suppress inbound attachments; tests cannot determine the intended compatibility policy.

options.title: Reuse 120-second policy
options.body: Thread FEISHU_MEDIA_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS into the idle wrapper so the hang is bounded without introducing a second, stricter Feishu timeout policy.

options.title: Approve fixed 30 seconds
options.body: Keep the stricter cutoff only with Feishu-owner approval and installed-SDK or live proof covering slow progress, timeout cleanup, and later-message processing.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the branch open until the Feishu timeout and delivery tradeoff has a confirmed owner decision.

recommendation.title: Reuse 120-second policy
recommendation.body: Thread FEISHU_MEDIA_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS into the idle wrapper so the hang is bounded without introducing a second, stricter Feishu timeout policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history records steipete reviewing and co-authoring the relevant Feishu media implementation.
